mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM real_estate_sales WHERE geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{bbox.minLng}, #{bbox.minLat}, #{bbox.maxLng}, #{bbox.maxLat}, 4326)

SELECT id, ST_Y(geom) AS lat, ST_X(geom) AS lng, building_name, deal_amount, exclusive_area, floor_no FROM real_estate_sales WHERE geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{bbox.minLng}, #{bbox.minLat}, #{bbox.maxLng}, #{bbox.maxLat}, 4326) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT region_cd, region_name, center_lat AS lat, center_lon AS lng, deal_count, avg_amount, max_amount FROM region_summary WHERE geom && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{bbox.minLng}, #{bbox.minLat}, #{bbox.maxLng}, #{bbox.maxLat}, 4326) ORDER BY region_cd
